 "topology": "6T CMOS Schmitt trigger + output inverter (non-inverting)",
 "rationale": "The 6T core's feedback NMOS raises vth_hi to about 1.1 V. The feedback PMOS, helped by the high pfet |Vth| that keeps the P stack off until vin < 0.8 V, lowers vth_lo to about 0.4 V. That gives roughly 0.7 V of hysteresis. Stack devices use L = 0.5 um with W around 1 um, so shoot-through flows only near the thresholds, under 20 uA peak and about 1-3 uW on average. The regenerative core plus an inverter gives rail-to-rail output."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wn":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),    # NMOS stack width [um]
    "Wp":  (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),    # PMOS stack width [um]
    "Ls":  (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),    # stack / feedback length [um]
    "kn":  (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),    # Wnf / Wn  -> raises vth_hi
    "kp":  (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),    # Wpf / Wp  -> lowers vth_lo
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    Wn, Wp, Ls = p["Wn"], p["Wp"], p["Ls"]
    Wnf = max(0.42, min(5000, p["kn"] * Wn))
    Wpf = max(0.42, min(5000, p["kp"] * Wp))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss")
    # 6T core (inverting at node x)
    n.M("MP1", "px", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)    # top PMOS
    n.M("MP2", "x",  "vin", "px",  "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)    # PMOS to output
    n.M("MN2", "x",  "vin", "nx",  "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)    # NMOS to output
    n.M("MN1", "nx", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)    # bottom NMOS
    n.M("MNF", "vdd", "x", "nx", "vss", "nfet", Wnf, Ls)     # feedback NMOS (M3)
    n.M("MPF", "vss", "x", "px", "vdd", "pfet", Wpf, Ls)     # feedback PMOS (M6)
    # output inverter -> non-inverting, rail-to-rail
    n.M("MPO", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.0, 0.15)
    n.M("MNO", "vout", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order threshold prediction using the LUT forward model ----
    vth_hi, vth_lo, ipk = 1.1, 0.4, 0.0
    try:
        vts = 0.5  # gate-source voltage at which MN2 can start pulling x down (P stack off)
        for vin in np.linspace(0.65, VDD, 116):
            nx = max(0.05, vin - vts)
            i1 = lut.op("n", Wn, Ls, vin, nx)["Id"]
            i3 = lut.op("n", Wnf, Ls, VDD - nx, VDD - nx, nx)["Id"]
            ipk = max(ipk, min(i1, i3))
            if i1 >= i3:
                vth_hi = vin
                break
        vtsp = 0.75
        for vin in np.linspace(VDD - 0.65, 0.0, 116):
            px = min(VDD - 0.05, vin + vtsp)
            ip1 = lut.op("p", Wp, Ls, VDD - vin, VDD - px)["Id"]
            i6 = lut.op("p", Wpf, Ls, px, px, VDD - px)["Id"]
            ipk = max(ipk, min(ip1, i6))
            if ip1 >= i6:
                vth_lo = vin
                break
    except Exception:
        ipk = 20e-6

    # Power: shoot-through only near the thresholds (~0.4 V window per edge on a 1.8 V / 10 us ramp)
    frac = 2 * 0.4 / (2 * VDD)
    power = VDD * ipk * 0.5 * frac + 0.2e-6
    return n, {"vth_hi": vth_hi, "vth_lo": vth_lo,
               "hysteresis": vth_hi - vth_lo, "power_avg": power}
